title: I get every beauty box :x love this one!
text: I really love the Allure  boxes ( what’s in them and the boxes themselves!) i think i always fall in love with at least one of the items in each box.  For some reason i was charged me shipping and Allure customer service was very nice and removed the shipping charges and were quick and very nice to work with :) i am excited for next box!
label: positive
